name: Sela Venn
seed: Convoy captain who helped Madger’s first settlers travel. Concealed Veyra’s funding of the second flood rescue; trust must be rebuilt when this emerges.
design: Female ibex, swept horns, weathered blue convoy coat, red cord around a brass whistle.
history: Latchford convoy worker from sixteen, captain by thirty. At forty-one she chartered Reedbank’s second evacuation using Veyra’s concealed funding and accepted secrecy to get eighteen households out safely.
desire: To make a promise of passage mean something real.
contradiction: Will hide a morally complicated detail if she thinks disclosure will break confidence in the route.
relationships: Madger trusts her; Veyra knows her omission; Lark admires her; Asha is an old colleague.
arc: The funding reveal costs her standing. She releases records, accepts another captain’s oversight and earns trust through subsequent choices.
story_engine: A timetable versus a stranded stranger; a return to a place she once chose to leave behind.
writer_truth: Her shame kept the funding secret after immediate danger passed. The rescue was real and the silence was a choice.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
